repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The candidate reverses the subtraction order in the condition. IR requires (v1 - v2) >= 20 to detect volume dropping, but candidate uses (v2 - v1) >= 20 which detects volume rising. F2 shows JoI triggered at 300000ms while IR did not. F3 line 4 confirms the wrong operand order.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed condition from (v2 - v1 >= 20) to (v1 - v2 >= 20) to match IR semantics. This preserves all other behavior (reads, delay, action, targets, arguments).
